{"values": [{"field": "Arrhenius Ea (eV)", "value": 0.33}, {"field": "Arrhenius notes", "value": "Apparent activation energy read from Fig. 2 (HP-PEO, triangle symbol) at salt weight fraction ~0.04 (O/Li = 100); approximate plot reading. The text says Ea is much lower in the dilute single-phase amorphous region (T > 65 °C) than the 0.7 eV of the two-phase domain, and that it depends on salt concentration and PEO purity."}, {"field": "Polymer system Notes", "value": "High purity, high molecular weight PEO (HP-PEO) synthesised with an anionic initiator (about 1 ppm, one initiator molecule per chain). It has a smaller polydispersity than commercial PEO and no detectable low molecular weight fraction, and is slightly less crystalline than electrolytes made with commercial PEO."}, {"field": "Polymer family", "value": "ether"}, {"field": "chain architecture", "value": "linear"}, {"field": "Polymer Mw (kDa)", "value": 1000}, {"field": "Solvent used", "value": "acetonitrile"}, {"field": "drying temp", "value": "45-50"}, {"field": "drying time (h)", "value": "48"}, {"field": "drying vacuum", "value": "yes"}, {"field": "Notes", "value": "O/Li = 100, LiCF3SO3 salt weight fraction ~0.04. Polymer dried under dynamic partial vacuum (5 mm Hg Ar) at 45-50 °C for 48 h; salt recrystallised from acetonitrile and dried at 100-110 °C for 48 h. Conductivity measured by ac impedance on the first temperature rise. MW is approximate (~1x10^6)."}, {"field": "Reference", "value": "D. Fauteux, J. Prud'homme, P.E. Harvey, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 923-928"}], "conductivity": []}

{"values": [{"field": "Arrhenius Ea (eV)", "value": 0.73}, {"field": "Arrhenius notes", "value": "Apparent activation energy read off Fig. 2 (C-PEO–LiCF3SO3, O/Li = 36, salt weight fraction ~0.09, T = 65 °C), so the value is approximate. {"values": [{"field": "crystalline?", "value": "yes"}, {"field": "Arrhenius Ea (eV)", "value": 0.66}, {"field": "Arrhenius notes", "value": "Apparent activation energy read off Fig. 2 (approximate, HP-PEO triangle at salt wt fraction ~0.23). The text says Ea is constant at about 0.7 eV in the two-phase (crystalline + amorphous) domain of PEO-LiCF3SO3, and that it does not depend on PEO purity."}, {"field": "Polymer system Notes", "value": "High-purity PEO (HP-PEO) made by anionic polymerization with about 1 ppm initiator (one molecule per chain). MW ≈ 1×10^6. Lower polydispersity than commercial PEO and no detectable low-MW fraction. HP-PEO electrolytes are slightly less crystalline than commercial-PEO electrolytes. At this composition (O/Li = 12) the electrolyte is two-phase: an amorphous phase plus a crystalline phase."}, {"field": "Polymer family", "value": "ether"}, {"field": "chain architecture", "value": "linear"}, {"field": "Solvent used", "value": "acetonitrile"}, {"field": "Notes", "value": "O/Li = 12 (Li:EO ≈ 0.083); LiCF3SO3 weight fraction ≈ 0.23. LiCF3SO3 was recrystallized from acetonitrile and dried under dynamic partial vacuum at 100-110 °C for 48 h. Harvey, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 923-928"}], "conductivity": []}
